name: Programming share of AI
question: How much AI use is coding?
metric: Share of OpenRouter tokens estimated to be programming, latest full month
solvedIf: Most AI use goes into writing software
trendLabel: Estimated share of OpenRouter tokens used for programming, in percent, per month.
caution: This covers one service, and developers may use it more than most people do, so it probably overstates the share across all AI.
OpenRouter estimates this from a sample of traffic, so small changes can be noise.
rule: Rising when programming takes a larger share of tokens than a year before.
scoreReason: About 26% of OpenRouter tokens are programming.
